Silakan hubungi penjual atau cek situs." But we might want to ask for more details or confirm. The user wants to know if there's a dozen size L underwear ready. We can respond politely: "Maaf, saya tidak memiliki akses ke inventaris. Apakah Anda ingin saya membantu mencari toko online?" Or "I don't have real-time inventory. Please check with store."
